key_insight: LeVo 2 improves full-length song generation by combining hierarchical representation modeling with progressive post-training, aiming to keep lyrics, structure, and audio quality aligned. It addresses the common trade-off between preserving global musical coherence and rendering detailed vocal/accompaniment acoustics.
problem_solved: The paper tackles full-song generation where models must stay coherent over long durations, follow lyrics and prompts, and produce realistic vocals plus accompaniment. It specifically addresses the limitation that mixed-token models blur track-specific detail, while dual-track models increase sequence length and reduce global planning ability.
method: Uses a hybrid LLM-Diffusion framework for controllable full-length song generation.
Introduces hierarchical representation modeling to capture both high-level song structure and finer track-level acoustic details.
Applies progressive post-training to gradually improve controllability, stability, and musicality during generation.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this suggests a practical path toward higher-quality long-form music generation without sacrificing either structure or fidelity. The approach may also generalize to other long-sequence generative tasks that need both global planning and detailed local rendering.

paper_title: LeVo 2: Stable and Melodious Song Generation via Hierarchical Representation Modeling and Progressive Post-Training
paper_authors: Shun Lei, Huaicheng Zhang, Dapeng Wu, Yaoxun Xu, Lishi Zuo
